note: T-15 PASSES the 7-sigma gate on the current cells: pooled over the 45-corner grid mean -1.8 ps, sigma 5.4 ps, sigma-to-spec 10.8 with lower confidence bound 10.3 against 7; no draw falls outside +-60 ps. Supersedes the failing 2026-11-10 record (mean +31.9 ps, sigma 11.4 ps), which predates the TX predriver NOR widening (89d803b, PR #164) and the aib_pad_esd XResd l=1u shortening (e47bb80, PR #332); both changes target the rise/fall asymmetry in this quantity; the two runs also differ in other inputs (the SS and FF diode sections changed from dio_tt to dio_ss and dio_ff in all four requests, and the ngspice engine moved from 46 to 47). The comparison shows the current cells pass under the current setup; it does not isolate how much of the improvement came from the resizes. The distribution is still not normal (Anderson-Darling rejected), so the empirical tail is the quantity to read: it is empty out to -20.7 ps. Pooled grid, as for T-10; per-corner reading in sim/mc/per_corner.md. Recorded, not tuned; the limit and the sigma convention are unchanged, and the 2026-11-10 records stay untouched.
